correctness.rationale: The complete row-plus-column sweep is derived exactly as a positive Möbius map. Its determinant equals Ba(1-a)(1-δ²)², giving one positive and one negative fixed point with exact eigenvalue-ratio conjugacy. Under b=a+κδ the map equals the Euler step of the stated Riccati field to uniform O(δ²) locally, and iterates and ODE stay in a common compact positive region; discrete Gronwall yields global O_T(δ). The rate follows by a uniform discriminant expansion and logarithmic Taylor remainder. The offdiagonal and marginal-residual formulas are exact. All 1692 finite checks pass; the limit relies on analytic proof, not on sampling.
